claim: On October 3, 2024 Aurora serverless DB clusters could be created with a maximum capacity of 256 Aurora capacity units (ACUs).
question: What maximum capacity can an Aurora serverless DB cluster have after October 2024?

values.display: maximum capacity of 256 Aurora capacity units (ACUs)

qualifiers.scope: per Aurora serverless DB instance (capacity range)
qualifiers.condition: needs a supported engine version; the guide's capacity table lists 0.5-128 ACUs for older engine versions

note: d27-077. Older exam material says 128 ACUs as the maximum. The October 2024 What's New post is blocked by robots.txt, so the old value comes only from the capacity table (0.5-128 for Aurora MySQL 3.02.0 and higher, Aurora PostgreSQL 13.6 and higher and similar).
